notes.title: BeerLeague Superstar Release
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Thanks for checking out BeerLeague Superstar.  It's my first completed game since 2014, and my first game on Steam! So I'm really excited for you to try it.  We are aiming for a [b]July 20th[/b] release, it may say July 7th, that was my ambitious release date but I'm still figuring this whole thing out! Hope you're all having an amazing summer.

Stay Ballin'

-Gabe
